translate_en|mods/CompanionDogsCorgi/com: A bright, affectionate Welsh drover with a long, low build and a complete natural tail. Nothing in the world frightens it, which is a virtue and a problem in equal measure. Real herding instinct, good obedience, and a reach so short that direct fighting is out of the question. Uncommon strays may be found around houses.
Your corgi has stationed itself between you and the stove. Cooking experience comes faster while it is nearby.
